args.task: init takes the harness command from --harness, as attach does, and assumes none when it is given (#249).
acceptance: init --harness "make check" on an empty directory records harness.command "make check" in construct.json and the CI workflow runs make check
a second init without --harness keeps the recorded "make check"
with --harness "make check" construct.model.json has no harness-steps claim and no claim names pnpm run quality

witnesses.criterion: init --harness "make check" on an empty directory records harness.command "make check" in construct.json and the CI workflow runs make check
witnesses.command: D=$(mktemp -d) && pnpm exec tsx src/cli.ts init --yes --preset node-library --dir $D --harness "make check" >/dev/null && node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]+"/construct.json","utf8"));const ci=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]+"/.github/workflows/ci.yml","utf8");if(m.harness?.command!=="make check"||!/run: make check\s*$/m.test(ci)){console.error(JSON.stringify(m.harness));process.exit(1)}' $D

witnesses.criterion: a second init without --harness keeps the recorded "make check"
witnesses.command: D=$(mktemp -d) && pnpm exec tsx src/cli.ts init --yes --preset node-library --dir $D --harness "make check" >/dev/null && pnpm exec tsx src/cli.ts init --yes --dir $D >/dev/null && node -e 'const m=JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1]+"/construct.json","utf8"));if(m.harness?.command!=="make check"){console.error(JSON.stringify(m.harness));process.exit(1)}' $D

witnesses.criterion: with --harness "make check" construct.model.json has no harness-steps claim and no claim names pnpm run quality
witnesses.command: D=$(mktemp -d) && pnpm exec tsx src/cli.ts init --yes --preset node-library --dir $D --harness "make check" >/dev/null && node -e 'const m=JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1]+"/construct.model.json","utf8"));const bad=m.claims.filter(c=>c.id==="harness-steps"||JSON.stringify(c).includes("pnpm run quality"));if(bad.length>0){console.error(bad.map(c=>c.id).join(","));process.exit(1)}' $D

invariants: init without --harness and without a record writes harness.command "pnpm run quality" and the harness-steps claim, exactly as before (`D=$(mktemp -d) && pnpm exec tsx src/cli.ts init --yes --preset node-library --dir $D >/dev/null && node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]+"/construct.json","utf8"));const mo=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]+"/construct.model.json","utf8"));if(m.harness?.command!=="pnpm run quality"||!mo.claims.some(c=>c.id==="harness-steps")){process.exit(1)}' $D`)
an empty directory → init --yes --preset <each preset> → pnpm install → pnpm run quality is green
